releases.notes:
- First test of updates from inside the program
- No functional changes

- Packages for macOS now carry a fixed beta signature
- No functional changes

- Second package with the fixed beta signature, to test that macOS keeps its permissions after an update
- No functional changes

- Audio mixer has its own tab; the Audio Mixer button opens it
- Fixed: Outputs could appear below the mixer
- First package for Windows (screen capture works; window capture, camera, sound and recording are untested there)

- Input settings open as movable windows; several can be open at once
- Colour correction per input: wheels or bars for lift, gamma, gain and offset, basic levels, colour tables (LUT, .cube)
- Monitor in the colour page: picture, waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope
- Sound delay per input and at the output
- Transitions Wipe, Zoom and Slide
- Add input opens as a window; untested on Windows: camera, recording, capture of single windows

- Feedback button: report a bug or ask for a feature from inside the program, with a picture of what you mean
- Add input and the Media page are sorted by kind: Video, Image, Audio file, Convert, Camera, Screen, Audio input, Title, Colour
- Drag a tile to reorder the inputs, or drop it on the preview or program picture; drop files from the Explorer onto the window to add them
- Undo and redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) for removing, moving, renaming and adding inputs
- Recording as MP4 or MOV (Settings, Recording); MP4 is the default on Windows
- Since beta.5 also: streaming, audio mixer with EQ, compressor and gate, stinger, cue lists, MultiView, several canvases, keyframes, lighting, tally, PTZ cameras and projectors – most of it not yet tested on real equipment
